tables.name: datasets
tables.label: Datasets
tables.description: Provenance rows: source, vintage, keyless/keyed, geography, citation — the data lineage spine.

tables.name: standards
tables.label: Standards
tables.description: FHWA / NCHRP-716 / TMIP / STOPS conformance frame for government-grade soundness.

tables.name: runs
tables.label: Run ledger
tables.description: One row per model run — the audit anchor. Each run pins a model_version (git sha), a confidence tier, and links to its input datasets and soundness checks.

tables.name: soundness_checks
tables.label: Soundness checks
tables.description: The 11-check automated audit (soundness_report.py) mapped to FHWA / NCHRP-716 / TMIP / STOPS. One row per check with pass/warn/fail + detail.

tables.name: confidence_tiers
tables.label: Confidence tiers
tables.description: The honesty rule: focused (calibrated to real sourced targets) vs exploratory (NCHRP-716 transferred anchors) — what earns each and what downgrades it.

tables.name: model_history
tables.label: Model history
tables.description: Versioned-run audit trail: each model_version sha with its date, what changed, and by whom.

tables.name: run_inputs
tables.label: Run inputs (join)
tables.description: JOIN run->dataset: which datasets fed which run. from=run_id, to=dataset_id, type 'uses'.

tables.name: run_checks
tables.label: Run checks (join)
tables.description: JOIN run->check: which soundness checks audited which run. from=run_id, to=check_id, type 'audits'.

tables.name: run_config
tables.label: Run settings
tables.description: A single editable row (id cfg) holding the run trigger's parameters — city, year, overrides, the /model endpoint, and an inert schedule cadence.
